title_en: 3-storey villa for sale in Yzberisht near the "Myslym Shima" School in Tirana (ID 4141034)
description_en: Property ID : 4141034 In Yzberisht, near the "Myslym Shima" School, a 3-storey villa for sale, 360 m² of land and 346 m² with mortgage, 4 bathrooms, veranda, corridor connecting all rooms, sunny orientation. The first floor with an area of 129.7 m² is organized in a living room, 2 bedrooms, a corridor connecting all rooms, a toilet, a veranda. The second floor with an area of 153 m² is organized in a living room, a kitchen, a toilet, a corridor, a bedroom, a veranda. The villa offers a panoramic view of Tirana. It is very suitable for a hotel. For sale: 265,000 euros.
